Subject: Trouble claiming NovaCorp org in Ariba — account creation blocked

Hi Alex,

We started the supplier registration for Redwood in Ariba this morning but hit an 'organization claim mismatch' error when trying to finalize the account. The form accepted our company name, but when we attempt to claim the NovaCorp entity the portal says the claim is already taken and prompts for an invite code which we don't have.

Screenshot attached (page_error_20261020.png). Can you confirm which entity Redwood should be claiming in Ariba and whether you can resend an invite/token? We also have the W9 ready and our bank details if you need them for the onboarding checklist.

Thanks,

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads up and the screenshot.

Short answer: we expect vendors to claim the vendor entity name 'NovaCorp LLC' (the legal entity we have on file). If the portal shows the claim is taken that usually means either: 1) someone from NovaCorp already created a root account with a different email, or 2) there is an Ariba tenant mapping mismatch.

Can you do two quick things for me?
- Reply with the exact company legal name you entered and the email that received the Ariba invite (if any).
- Upload the signed W9 and a bank-detail PDF to the Drive link below so I can share them with procurement (we can redact account numbers in flight).

I've attached our onboarding checklist so you can see what fields we (procurement) will validate on our side. If we need to request an invite code from our procurement portal admin I'll loop them in.

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/onboarding/PO-98765/checklist
Attachment: redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding a vendor issue that blocked the account creation. Samir at NovaCorp hit an 'organization claim mismatch' when trying to claim 'NovaCorp LLC' in Ariba. He attached a screenshot and says they haven't received an invite code.

Can procurement check if we have an outstanding vendor invite for NovaCorp (PO-98765) in our Ariba tenant or if there's an orphaned claim tied to a different email? If tenant-side invite is missing, procurement should be able to generate a new invite code or map the claim. If legal needs a different match (legal name vs. dba), let me know and I'll coordinate with the NovaCorp contact.

For reference I asked Samir to upload W9 and bank stub; they said they'll send it.

Thanks,
Alex

Hi Alex,

Thanks — we uploaded the W9 and a redacted bank stub here: https://drive.redwood.com/onboarding/PO-98765/vendor-uploads (files: W9_NovaCorp.pdf, bank_details_redacted.pdf). The legal name we used was 'NovaCorp LLC' and the contact email on the registration was payments@novacorp.com.

I checked with our side and there was an old admin who had registered a parent account with a different email; they've given me the invite code and we've been able to claim the entity. We still saw a minor mapping warning, but Ariba allowed us to proceed after entering the invite code.

Please confirm if you see the vendor record on your Ariba side and we can move to PO acknowledgement.
